input.command:
git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
tests: cover the X button, re-press recovery, and progress bar

The three fixes from the last review had no automated guard because each one
needs live UI state. Lifting the real functions out of the source and running
them against stubbed globals covers the logic without a UI:

- overlay mouse callback: X mid-recording calls emergencyStop() instead of
  stranding ffmpeg, the canvas delete stays deferred (hs.canvas ignores a
  delete issued from inside its own mouse callback), and unpinning does not
  hide the overlay while recording
- startRecording(): a re-press inside the finalization window flushes the
  pending dictation and still starts the new recording
- updateProgressBar(): the frozen recordedSecs keeps the 90% auto-expand from
  re-tripping after the key is released, so the blue bar reaches the red one

Also pins the declaration order of overlayPinned/isRecording/hideOverlay above
createOverlay, and checks BAR_MAX against the bar_bg track width.

Each check was verified against a one-line mutation of the current file, and
fails only on the bug it guards.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1
